title: Finite intrinsic derived pullback presentation
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism. Use the small pro-etale inverse image and the constant-ring module categories [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Transport fixed-scalar inverse image through the canonical constant-module realization equivalences to define $f^*_{\mathrm{int}}$. Define its unbounded derived functor by exact termwise descent to the derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Pullback composition is the transported fixed-scalar composition followed by insertion of the intermediate realization unit, and the identity comparison is its realization counit. These are the existing sfIntrinsicPullback, sfIntrinsicDerivedPullback, sfIntrinsicPullbackComp and sfIntrinsicPullbackId constructions, with the published constant-section normalization, not a new choice of coefficient identification.
